steps.action: Build two toast slices (1x4 plate, two staggered layers of 1x2 bricks, 1x4 plate, two slopes on top) and push them down into the toaster's two slots with the slopes facing the same side.
watch_for: Offset the second layer of 1x2 bricks so they overlap the joint below
Both slopes on each slice point the same way, toward the left as drawn
Rotate the model as shown by the turn-around icon before inserting
